authorization: User requested merge and continued next steps on 2026-10-03; this scope fits a bounded local statistical diagnostic. No formal model-study admission, paid calls, remote compute or production promotion.
selection: Metadata-only SHA-256 order over selection_salt:role:record_id, then record_id. Original BGC singleton groups only, no review-required or overlay-touched groups, and source role must equal effective role in train/dev. No label balancing, retries or post-score sample changes. Source test ZIP member remains unopened; skipped frames in allowed members are streamed as bytes without text decoding.
source_semantics: Recover observed positives in the existing authored 48-label mapping, separately within genre/topic/form/audience. Omitted labels stay unknown. Existing source-preparation training flags and all human review slots remain unchanged; zero source negatives and zero human-gold labels.
input: Literal title plus newline plus description, with no category, author, URL or identifier metadata. Vocabulary and IDF fit selected training texts only. The fixed scikit-learn text transform is applied after source input verification.
rankers: Frequency ranks training positive counts. Label-name cosine uses canonical label IDs with underscores replaced by spaces. Positive-centroid cosine uses normalized mean training TF-IDF vectors for each observed-positive label. Preserve all mapped labels, including zero-support labels. Sort by descending score then label ID for exact ties. No calibration or learned thresholds.
evaluation: Fixed development-only observed-positive recall at 1/3/5 and first-observed-positive reciprocal rank per facet. One row per group; group macro and observed-label macro recall, per-label support and misses reported. Facets with no observed positives are excluded from their denominators and counted. k is clipped to facet vocabulary size and actual k reported. No precision/F1/accuracy, negative-label loss, best-run selection or significance claim.

review.purpose: Hash-selected training-only worksheet using the existing source-first review UI. Record evidence and explicit unknown decisions; no generated human labels or accuracy claims.

limitations: Conservative singleton/source-role subset is not the full BGC population or a verified literary-work partition.
Mapped labels inherit publisher and mapping biases; known positives are incomplete and some targets overlap hierarchically.
Descriptions may explicitly state a genre; this is permitted available-input evidence, not proof of literary understanding.
Both target selection and the existing mapping were prepared previously; this development diagnostic is not a confirmatory test.
A high recall at large k can be trivial for small facets and says nothing about false positives.
Source collection terms and this research diagnostic do not grant product deployment rights.
